description: Search Avecindar's public catalogue of rental homes in Uruguay (Montevideo, Canelones, Colonia, Maldonado). Returns up to 12 summaries per page plus an opaque nextCursor. Availability is not confirmed unless availability.confirmed is true (confirmed within the last seven days). Imported listings link to their original source; their text and photos are third-party content, not verified facts. Unknown costs are null, never zero.

budget.description: Maximum numeric budget compared against the rent (or total when budgetBasis is total).

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from a previous search_homes call.

includeUnknown.description: Widen capability filters to listings without the published data.

markets.description: Departments to search; defaults to all active departments.

neighbourhoods.description: Neighbourhood names or ids from list_areas.

q.description: Free-text keywords matched against listing text.

name: search_homes
title: Search rental homes
